words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: adj. 大众市场的；大批量销售的
words.ex: The company launched a mass-market product that quickly gained popularity.
words.ex_cn: 该公司推出了一款面向大众的产品，迅速获得了欢迎。
words.en: A mass-market product is designed to appeal to a large number of people and is usually sold at a relatively low price.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.tr: n. 弗吉尼亚州（美国东部的一个州）；
words.ex: She lives in Virginia near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 她住在靠近海岸的弗吉尼亚州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern United States, known for its significant role in American history, including the first permanent English settlement at Jamestown.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: The new park has better accessibility for wheelchair users.
words.ex_cn: 这个新公园为轮椅使用者提供了更好的可及性。
words.en: The quality of being able to be reached or entered.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.tr:
v. 使模糊；使看不清；弄污
n. 模糊
words.ex: The rain made the lights blur.
words.ex_cn: 雨使灯光变得模糊。
words.en: If something blurs your vision, it makes you unable to see things clearly.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr: v. 咨询；“consult”的现在分词； adj. 作顾问的；咨询的；
words.ex: He consults his doctor for advice.
words.ex_cn: 他向医生咨询建议。
words.en: Consulting is the business of giving expert advice to other professionals, especially in business.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.ex: My granny makes apple pie every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶每周日都做苹果派。
words.en: A granny is an informal term for a grandmother, typically used in a familiar or affectionate manner.

words.tr: n. 暗示；提示；有益的建议；
words.ex: He gave me a hint about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于惊喜派对的暗示。
words.en: A hint is a slight or indirect indication or suggestion.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.ex: His laziness made him miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他的懒惰让他错过了公交车。
words.en: The state of being unwilling to work or use energy; idleness.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.tr: adj. 宏伟的；壮丽的；威严的；
words.ex: The majestic mountain stood above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 那座宏伟的山峰耸立在云层之上。
words.en: If you describe something as majestic, you mean that it has a quality of greatness and impressiveness that often inspires admiration or awe.

words.ex: The nobility lived in large castles and owned much land.
words.ex_cn: 贵族住在大城堡里，拥有大量土地。
words.en: The quality of being noble in character, mind, birth, or rank.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；愉悦的；
words.ex: The trip was a pleasurable experience.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行是一次令人愉快的经历。
words.en: Something that is pleasurable is enjoyable or gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有九个女王。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.ex: The plane landed on the runway.
words.ex_cn: 飞机降落在跑道上。
words.en: A runway is a strip of land where aircraft take off and land.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.tr: adv. 社会上；交际上；以社会方式地；
words.ex: He is socially active in his community.
words.ex_cn: 他在社会上积极参与社区活动。
words.en: In a way that relates to society or its organization.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: It is unreasonable to expect help without asking.
words.ex_cn: 不请求帮助就指望别人帮忙是不合理的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unreasonable, you mean that they are behaving in a way that is not fair or sensible.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；极大的； v. “whop”的现在分词；
words.ex: He won a whopping prize of $10,000.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了一笔巨大的奖金，一万美元。
words.en: A whopping amount is extremely large.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr: n. 美食；佳肴；外购食物; n. （Cate）人名；（法、德、葡）卡特；（英）凯特
words.ex: He cate a fish from the river.
words.ex_cn: 他从河里钓了一条鱼。
words.en: Cate refers to a choice or dainty food; a delicacy.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.tr:
n. 黑暗；忧郁；幽暗
v. 变阴暗；变忧郁
words.ex: The room was filled with gloom after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间里一片黑暗。
words.en: Gloom is a feeling of sadness and lack of hope.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.tr: adj. 不适当的；不正当的；不成体统的
words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is improper.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去开会是不适当的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as improper, you mean that it is rude or shocking.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他明天会来。
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: I thank you for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我谢谢你帮助我。
words.en: to express gratitude or appreciation to someone for something they have done

words.ex: The unfairness of the tax system has been widely criticized.
words.ex_cn: 税收制度的不公平性受到了广泛的批评。
words.en: The quality of being unjust or inequitable.

words.tr:
v. （使）回旋；（使）旋转
n. 一连串的事；混乱；尝试
words.ex: The wind makes the leaves whirl around.
words.ex_cn: 风让树叶旋转飞舞。
words.en: To move or cause to move rapidly around and around.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.ex: Some people follow that cult blindly.
words.ex_cn: 有些人盲目追随那个狂热崇拜。
words.en: A cult is a group of people who have extreme admiration for a particular person, idea, or thing, often following unusual or extreme practices or beliefs.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: The quilt is a patchwork of old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这条被子是用旧衣服拼凑而成的。
words.en: Patchwork is a form of needlework that involves sewing together pieces of fabric into a larger design. The larger design is usually based on repeating patterns built up with different fabric shapes (which can be different colors).

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: Wearing those old shoes is unfashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿那双旧鞋不时髦了。
words.en: If you describe something as unfashionable, you mean that it is not popular or fashionable at the present time.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: This book is a best-seller in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在许多国家都是畅销书。
words.en: A best-seller is a book or other product that sells in very large numbers.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.tr: adj. 虚弱的；衰弱的；无力的；
words.ex: The old man gave a feeble smile.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人露出虚弱的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as feeble, you mean that they are weak.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: His inability to swim saved him from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 他不会游泳，这救了他一命。
words.en: If you refer to someone's inability to do something, you are emphasizing that they cannot do it.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.tr: adj. 不利的；不赞成的；相反的
words.ex: The weather is unfavourable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气不适合野餐。
words.en: If you describe a situation, condition, or opinion as unfavourable, you mean that it is harmful, inconvenient, or not likely to lead to success.

words.tr:
n. 艺术名家；音乐演奏名家
adj. 技艺精湛的；功力深厚的
words.ex: He is a virtuoso on the violin.
words.ex_cn: 他是小提琴方面的天才。
words.en: A virtuoso is someone who is extremely skilled at doing something, especially playing a musical instrument.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: His smile seemed insincere.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑显得不真心。
words.en: If you say that someone is insincere, you are being critical of them because they say things they do not really mean, usually pleasant, admiring, or encouraging things.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.ex: The parity of the numbers is important in this game.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的奇偶性在这个游戏中很重要。
words.en: If there is parity between two things, they are equal to each other.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.tr: adj. 谋取私利的；自私自利的
words.ex: He made a self-serving excuse to avoid blame.
words.ex_cn: 他找了一个自私的借口来推卸责任。
words.en: If you describe someone as self-serving, you are critical of them because they are only interested in what they can get for themselves.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: He believes in God.
words.ex_cn: 他相信上帝。
words.en: In monotheistic religions, God is the supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: He always speaks highly of his pater.
words.ex_cn: 他总是高度评价他的父亲。
words.en: A father; the male parent of a child.

words.ex: I can't recollect where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you recollect something, you remember it.

words.tr: adj. 世俗的；非宗教的；长期的
words.ex: He lives a secular life without religion.
words.ex_cn: 他过着没有宗教的世俗生活。
words.en: Secular activities, attitudes, or things have no connection with religion.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.tr: adj. 未聚焦的；不集中的；漫不经心的；目的不明确的
words.ex: He was unfocused during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间心不在焉。
words.en: If someone's eyes are unfocused, they are open but not looking at anything in particular. If your thoughts or your discussion are unfocused, they are not clear or not concentrated on a particular subject.

words.tr: adj. 品行端正的；品德高的；
words.ex: He is a virtuous man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个品行端正的人，总是说真话。
words.en: Having or showing high moral standards.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The default setting is on.
words.ex_cn: 默认设置是开启的。
words.en: If a person, company, or country defaults on something that they have legally agreed to do, such as paying a debt or keeping to an agreement, they fail to do it.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: adj. 天生的；先天的；天赋的
words.ex: He has an inborn talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他天生就有音乐才能。
words.en: An inborn quality or ability is one that you have had naturally since birth.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.tr:
n. 拭子；药签；吸取的液体；抹布；拖把
v. 用拭子拭抹或擦净（某物）；（用拖把、抹布等）擦洗（某物）
words.ex: The nurse uses a swab to clean the wound.
words.ex_cn: 护士用棉签清洁伤口。
words.en: A swab is a small piece of cotton or other absorbent material attached to the end of a stick or wire, used for cleaning wounds or applying medication.

words.tr: n. 神学；宗教学；宗教信仰学
words.ex: He is studying theology at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习神学。
words.en: Theology is the study of the nature of God and religious belief.

words.tr: n. 演变； v. 展开；“unfold”的现在分词；
words.ex: The unfolding of events surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 事件的演变让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The process of developing or being revealed.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: The router has low bandwidth, so videos load slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这个路由器带宽很低，所以视频加载很慢。
words.en: Bandwidth refers to the maximum rate of data transfer across a given path.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.tr:
n. 手提行李
adj. 手提的
words.ex: She has a small carry-on bag for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 她有一个小手提行李箱用于航班。
words.en: A carry-on is a piece of luggage that passengers are allowed to take with them into the cabin of an aircraft.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.ex: He erased the wrong answer with an eraser.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。
words.en: To erase something means to remove it completely from a surface or from a place where it is stored.

words.tr: v. 幻想；想象；做白日梦
words.ex: He fantasizes about winning the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他幻想自己中彩票。
words.en: To fantasize means to imagine something that is very pleasant or exciting, but is very unlikely to happen.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.ex: The old man prays for holiness every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人每天早上祈祷追求圣洁。
words.en: The state or quality of being holy; sanctity.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: The investigator asked the witness a few simple questions.
words.ex_cn: 调查员问了证人几个简单的问题。
words.en: An investigator is someone whose job is to investigate a crime, accident, or other matter.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 压迫的；沉重的；难以忍受的；闷热的
words.ex: The oppressive heat made it hard to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 令人窒息的炎热让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a society, its laws, or customs as oppressive, you think they treat people in an unfair and cruel way and prevent them from having opportunities and freedom.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr: n. 小笔记本；钱夹；袖珍本；财力
words.ex: He wrote the phone number in his pocketbook.
words.ex_cn: 他把电话号码写在了他的小笔记本里。
words.en: A pocketbook is a small book, especially one that can be carried in a pocket, or a woman's handbag.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The reader enjoyed the novel very much.
words.ex_cn: 这位读者非常喜欢这本小说。
words.en: A person who reads or who is fond of reading.

words.ex: They will remodel their kitchen next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月要重新装修厨房。
words.en: To remodel something means to change its structure or form, often to improve it.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.ex: The farm has a big storehouse for grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有一个存放谷物的大仓库。
words.en: A storehouse is a building where things are stored.

words.ex: The offer is time-limited, so you need to make a decision quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个优惠是有时间限制的，所以你需要尽快做出决定。
words.en: Something that is time-limited is only available or valid for a specific period of time.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr: adj. 脾气好的；温厚的；和蔼的
words.ex: She was always good-natured and willing to help.
words.ex_cn: 她总是很和善，乐于助人。
words.en: A good-natured person is friendly and does not easily get angry.

words.ex: Here is your book.
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书。
words.en: in or at this place or position

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr: adj. 不标准的，不规范的（词、发音）
words.ex: He uses non-standard methods to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用非标准的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Not conforming to the standard; deviating from the norm or usual.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.tr: v. 重新考虑；重新审议
words.ex: He must reconsider his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他必须重新考虑他的决定。
words.en: If you reconsider a decision or opinion, you think about it and try to decide whether it should be changed.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: adj. 议会的；国会的；大会的
words.ex: The congressional meeting lasted all day.
words.ex_cn: 国会会议持续了一整天。
words.en: Relating to a congress, especially the United States Congress.

words.ex: He sweats heavily after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后大量出汗。
words.en: Sweat is the salty liquid that comes out through the skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.ex: The book is 10 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这本书长10英寸。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.tr:
n. 巡逻
v. 巡逻
words.ex: The police patrol the street at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察晚上在街上巡逻。
words.en: A patrol is a group of soldiers or vehicles that are guarding a place at a particular time. Patrol can also refer to the act of moving around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe.

words.ex: They will reconstruct the old bridge next year.
words.ex_cn: 他们明年将重建这座旧桥。
words.en: If you reconstruct something that has been destroyed or badly damaged, you build it and make it work again.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.ex: The terrorists hijacked a plane and flew it to another country.
words.ex_cn: 恐怖分子劫持了一架飞机，飞到了另一个国家。
words.en: To hijack a vehicle or aircraft is to take control of it by force, often in order to steal it or to use it for a purpose other than its intended one.

words.tr:
n. 劫持
v. 劫持
words.ex: The criminals planned to highjack the plane and demand a ransom.
words.ex_cn: v. 犯罪分子计划劫持飞机并要求赎金。
words.en: To seize control of a vehicle, especially an aircraft, by force or threat of force.

words.ex: The talk was meaningless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这场谈话毫无意义且无聊。
words.en: If something is meaningless, it has no meaning, or seems to have no meaning.

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular way, it appears to be that way.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: He set the thermostat to 22 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 他把恒温器调到了22度。
words.en: A thermostat is a device that automatically regulates temperature, or that activates a device when the temperature reaches a certain point.

words.tr: adj. 难以置信的；不可想象的；
words.ex: The damage from the storm was unimaginable.
words.ex_cn: 风暴造成的破坏难以置信。
words.en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand because it is not part of people's normal experience.

words.tr: n. 统一派；工会主义者
words.ex: The unionist supports keeping the country united.
words.ex_cn: 统一派支持保持国家统一。
words.en: A unionist is a person who supports or belongs to a trade union, or someone who supports the union of different groups or countries.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr: adj. 贴邻的；毗连的； v. “adjoin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two houses are adjoining.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子是贴邻的。
words.en: Adjoining is used to describe something that is next to or joined with something else.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 很少有人来参加会议。
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.tr:
adj. 沸腾的；火热的
v. 沸腾；翻涌；骚动；激昂；大发雷霆；“seethe”的现在分词
words.ex: The pot was seething with boiling water.
words.ex_cn: 锅里水正沸腾着。
words.en: If you say that someone is seething, you mean that they are very angry, but are trying not to show it.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.tr: adj. 知识不够的；不了解情况的；愚昧的
words.ex: He made a decision without knowing the facts, so he was uninformed.
words.ex_cn: 他没有了解事实就做了决定，所以他是无知的。
words.en: If you describe someone as uninformed, you mean that they have very little knowledge or information about a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.tr: adj. （指坏事）故意的; （指人）任性的，固执的
words.ex: He made a wilful mistake on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意犯了一个顽固的错误。
words.en: If you describe actions or attitudes as wilful, you are critical of them because they are done or expressed deliberately, especially with the intention of causing harm, or they show a stubborn and determined desire to do what you want, regardless of what anyone else thinks.

words.tr: adj. 任性的；故意的；蓄意的
words.ex: The willful child refused to eat his vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个任性的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you describe actions or attitudes as willful, you are critical of them because they are done or expressed deliberately, especially with the intention of causing harm, or they are stubborn and unreasonable.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.ex: The boy defied his parents by staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为熬夜不回家而违抗了父母。
words.en: If you defy someone or something, you refuse to obey them or you do something that they do not allow.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: She walked with grace across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地走过舞台。
words.en: Grace is the quality of being pleasant, polite, and dignified, or a period of time allowed for something to be done.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: The turtle outlives the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟比兔子活得长。
words.en: To live longer than someone else; to survive something.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.tr:
v. 赢；获得；
n. 胜利；赢得；
words.ex: I want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我想赢这场比赛。
words.en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.ex: I don't like coffee anymore.
words.ex_cn: 我不再喜欢咖啡了。
words.en: If something does not happen or is not true anymore, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.ex: The two roads converge at the town center.
words.ex_cn: 这两条路在镇中心交汇。
words.en: If roads or lines converge, they meet or join at a particular place.

words.tr:
adj. 狡猾的；奸诈的；巧妙的
n. 奸诈；狡猾
words.ex: The cunning fox tricked the chicken.
words.ex_cn: 那只狡猾的狐狸骗了鸡。
words.en: Someone who is cunning is clever and good at deceiving others in order to get what they want.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.ex: He formally accepted the award at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上正式接受了奖项。
words.en: in a formal manner

words.tr:
n. 基层；基层民众；草根
adj. 基层的；草根的；乡村的
words.ex: The grassroots movement started in small towns.
words.ex_cn: 这个基层运动起源于小镇。
words.en: The grassroots of an organization or movement are the ordinary people who form the main part of it, rather than its leaders.

words.ex: The homebuyer signed the contract yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这位购房者昨天签了合同。
words.en: A homebuyer is a person who is in the process of buying a house or flat.

words.ex: The dark clouds are an indication of rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是下雨的迹象。
words.en: An indication is a sign which suggests, for example, what people are thinking or feeling.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr: adj. 非自愿的；不由自主的；
words.ex: His hand moved in an involuntary way.
words.ex_cn: 他的手不自觉地动了一下。
words.en: If you make an involuntary movement or exclamation, you make it suddenly and without intending to because you are unable to control yourself.

words.ex: His legacy includes many charity schools.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗产包括许多慈善学校。
words.en: Something handed down from an ancestor or a predecessor or from the past.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；法定的；义务的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制的。
words.en: If something is mandatory, it is required by law or by a rule or regulation.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr: n. 轨道飞行器；航天飞行器；
words.ex: The orbiter circled the planet for months.
words.ex_cn: 轨道飞行器在行星周围环绕了数月。
words.en: An orbiter is a spacecraft designed to go into orbit, especially one that does not also land on a planet or moon.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.ex: The issue polarized the community into two opposing groups.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题使社区分裂成了两个对立的群体。
words.en: To polarize means to cause something, especially a group or an issue, to divide into two sharply contrasting groups or sets of opinions or beliefs.

words.ex: The judge considered the reasonableness of the defendant's actions.
words.ex_cn: 法官考虑了被告行为的合理性。
words.en: The quality of being based on good sense or sound judgment; fairness.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.tr:
v. （使）发出沙沙；偷窃（牲口）
n. 沙沙声；瑟瑟声
words.ex: The wind rustled the leaves.
words.ex_cn: 风使树叶发出沙沙声。
words.en: If something rustles, it makes soft sounds as it moves lightly and gently, for example through the air or over dry leaves.

words.ex: This problem is solvable with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题用简单的数学就能解决。
words.en: If a problem or puzzle is solvable, it can be solved or answered.

words.tr: n. （英）按能力分组； v. “stream”的现在分词；流；流动；
words.ex: The school uses streaming to group students by ability in math.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校通过按能力分组来安排学生的数学课程。
words.en: The transmission or reception of data (especially video and audio material) over a computer network as a steady, continuous flow, allowing playback to start while the rest of the data is still being received.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: The teacher gave timely help when I was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到困难时，老师及时提供了帮助。
words.en: done or occurring at a favorable or useful time; opportune.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.tr: adj. 没有回应的；漠不关心的；没反应的
words.ex: The phone is unresponsive after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 手机摔了之后没反应了。
words.en: If someone is unresponsive, they do not react or respond to something such as an action, a question, or a new idea.

words.tr: n. 投票者；选民；选举人
words.ex: The voter cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 这位选民在选举中投了票。
words.en: A voter is a person who votes or has the right to vote in an election.

words.ex: The widow lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位寡妇独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A widow is a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: The soil degrades over time without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有适当照料，土壤会逐渐退化。
words.en: If something degrades or is degraded, it becomes worse in quality, or weaker in power or status.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The problem recurs every week.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题每周都会再次出现。
words.en: If something recurs, it happens again, either once or several times.

words.tr: adj. 不自然的；忸怩的；难为情的
words.ex: He felt self-conscious when speaking in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时感到不自然。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as self-conscious, you mean that they are strongly aware of who or what they are.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 繁重的；累赘的；难于负担的
words.ex: The homework was burdensome and took all night.
words.ex_cn: 作业负担沉重，花了一整晚时间。
words.en: If you describe something as burdensome, you mean it is very difficult to cope with or manage because it is so heavy, large, or complex.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.ex: The country made a unilateral decision to close the border.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家单方面决定关闭边境。
words.en: Involving only one group or country.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: A cascade of complaints flooded the office.
words.ex_cn: 大量投诉涌进了办公室。
words.en: A cascade is a small waterfall or a series of small waterfalls. As a verb, it means to flow or fall in or like a cascade.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.ex: The cave is an unexplored place.
words.ex_cn: 这个洞穴是一个未探索的地方。
words.en: If you describe something as unexplored, you mean that it has not been fully investigated or that little is known about it.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr: adj. 西班牙的；西班牙和葡萄牙的；拉丁美洲的
words.ex: He is a Hispanic student from Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自西班牙的西班牙裔学生。
words.en: relating to Spain or to Spanish-speaking countries, especially those of Latin America.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: We can redefine the rules to make the game more fun.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以重新定义规则，让游戏更有趣。
words.en: To define something again or differently, especially in order to give it a new or improved meaning.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.tr: n. （单位面积或体积内的）生物量
words.ex: The farm uses biomass to make heat.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场用生物质来制造热量。
words.en: Biomass refers to the total mass of living organisms in a given area or volume, or organic material that comes from plants and animals, and it is a renewable energy source.

words.ex: The law constrains companies from polluting rivers.
words.ex_cn: 法律约束公司不得污染河流。
words.en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: The benefits outweigh the risks.
words.ex_cn: 好处超过了风险。
words.en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.

words.ex: The doctor tested his semen for fertility.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的精液以评估生育能力。
words.en: The thick, whitish fluid secreted by the male reproductive organs, containing spermatozoa and capable of fertilizing the female ovum.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
