words.ex_cn: 他的意识形态基于平等与正义。
words.en: An ideology is a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people think and behave.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.tr:
v. 飞翔；飞行；
n. 苍蝇；
words.ex: Birds fly in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中飞翔。
words.en: To move through the air using wings; or a small insect with two wings.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: Jesus is the Christ in Christian belief.
words.ex_cn: 在基督教信仰中，耶稣是基督。
words.en: Christ is the title given to Jesus, especially in the Christian religion, and it is also used as a name.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: He felt guilt after lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在对朋友撒谎后感到内疚。
words.en: Guilt is an unhappy feeling that you have because you have done something wrong or think that you have done something wrong.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: He misunderstands the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了这些说明。
words.en: If you misunderstand someone or something, you do not understand them properly.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.ex: He dreams of a perfect utopia where everyone is happy.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想一个每个人都很幸福的完美乌托邦。
words.en: An imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr:
n. 铬；铬合金；铬黄
v. 镀以铬
words.ex: Chrome is a metal used in car parts.
words.ex_cn: 铬是一种用于汽车零件的金属。
words.en: Chrome is a hard, shiny metal that is used to cover other metals to prevent them from rusting and to make them look more attractive.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.tr: adj. 混合的；混杂的； v. 混合；“mix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He ate a mixed salad with tomatoes and cucumbers.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一份混合沙拉，里面有番茄和黄瓜。
words.en: If something is mixed, it consists of different things or people.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.tr:
n. 抵制；拒绝参加；
v. 抵制；拒绝参加；
words.ex: The students organized a boycott of the unfair school rule.
words.ex_cn: 学生们组织了对这项不公平校规的抵制。
words.en: If a country, group, or person boycotts a country, organization, or activity, they refuse to be involved with it in any way because they disapprove of it.

words.ex: Each cell has 46 chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 每个细胞有46条染色体。
words.en: A chromosome is a thread-like structure of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: The crowd fell into hysteria when the fire alarm sounded.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了情绪失控。
words.en: Hysteria is a state of extreme excitement, fear, or anger in which people cannot control their emotions or behavior.

words.ex: The old man is infirm and needs help to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人身体虚弱，需要帮助才能走路。
words.en: If someone is infirm, they are weak or ill, and often old.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.ex: They found an archaeological site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们在河边发现了一个考古遗址。
words.en: Relating to the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.tr: n. 英国退出欧盟（British exit from the EU）
words.ex: Brexit changed the economy of the UK.
words.ex_cn: 英国脱欧改变了英国的经济。
words.en: Brexit is the withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the European Union. It is a portmanteau of 'Britain' and 'exit'.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: There is a dearth of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: A dearth of something is a lack or scarcity of it.

words.ex: The downside of this job is the long hours.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的负面是工作时间很长。
words.en: The downside of something is the aspect of it which is less positive, pleasant, or useful than its other aspects.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: She is a housewife who takes care of her children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位照顾孩子的家庭主妇。
words.en: A housewife is a woman who stays at home and looks after her children and her house.

words.tr: v. 大批出没于；成群滋扰；遍布于；寄生
words.ex: The bugs infest the old house.
words.ex_cn: 这些虫子侵袭了这栋老房子。
words.en: If creatures such as insects or rats infest a place, they are present in large numbers and usually cause damage or disease.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: He achieved maximal efficiency with minimal effort.
words.ex_cn: 他以最小的努力达到了最大的效率。
words.en: Maximal means the greatest or highest possible in degree or amount.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.ex: He is a famous novelist who writes stories about love.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的作家，写关于爱情的故事。
words.en: A novelist is a person who writes novels.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.tr:
n. 波利尼西亚人；
adj. 波利尼西亚（人）的；
words.ex: The Polynesian sailed across the Pacific Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这位波利尼西亚人横渡了太平洋。
words.en: Of or relating to Polynesia, its people, or their languages.

words.tr: adv. 鲁莽地；不顾后果地
words.ex: He drove recklessly through the city streets.
words.ex_cn: 他鲁莽地在城市街道上驾驶。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.tr: n. 蜂腰，形容女性腰部极细
words.ex: She has a wasp-waist that makes her look very elegant.
words.ex_cn: 她有着蜂腰，让她看起来非常优雅。
words.en: A very narrow waist, especially in a woman, resembling the waist of a wasp.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The spy practiced espionage to get secret information.
words.ex_cn: 间谍从事间谍活动以获取秘密信息。
words.en: The practice of spying or of using spies, typically by governments to obtain political and military information.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: The farmer shears sheep every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每年春天给羊剪毛。
words.en: To shear means to cut the wool off a sheep or to cut or trim something with scissors or shears.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；
adj. 仿制的；
words.ex: They mock him for his accent.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他口音而嘲笑他。
words.en: To mock someone means to laugh at them, tease them, or make them look foolish, often by imitating their behavior or speech.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: The townsfolk gathered at the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 镇上的人们在广场上聚集参加节日。
words.en: The people living in a town, considered as a group.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: adj. 低水平的；低级别的
words.ex: He uses a low-level language to control the hardware.
words.ex_cn: 他使用低级语言来控制硬件。
words.en: relating to or being at a low level, especially in terms of importance, complexity, or rank

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.tr: n. 非正式；不拘礼节；亲切随便
words.ex: The teacher likes informality in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师喜欢课堂上的随意氛围。
words.en: The state or quality of being informal; absence of formality.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: He earned the esteem of his colleagues through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。
words.en: If you esteem someone or something, you respect or admire them.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: He was solely motivated by the prospect of lucre.
words.ex_cn: 他唯一被钱财的前景所驱动。
words.en: Money, especially when regarded as sordid or distasteful or gained in a dishonorable way.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: He will remold the clay into a new shape.
words.ex_cn: 他将把泥土重新塑造成一个新的形状。
words.en: To remold means to shape or form something again, especially in a different way.

words.tr:
v. 改造；改铸
n. 翻新轮胎
words.ex: He tried to remould the clay into a new shape.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把黏土重新塑造成一个新的形状。
words.en: To change or alter the nature, character, or appearance of something.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里开拖拉机。
words.en: A tractor is a powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment and trailers.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.tr: adj. 野蛮的；无人性的；残忍的
words.ex: The prison conditions were inhuman.
words.ex_cn: 监狱的条件十分野蛮。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inhuman, you mean that they are extremely cruel or unpleasant.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.tr:
n. 船；舰；
v. 装运；
words.ex: The ship sailed across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了海洋。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr:
n. 寒冷；寒意；
v. 变冷；使冰冷；
words.ex: The chill of the morning made me wear a jacket.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的寒冷让我穿上了夹克。
words.en: A chill is a feeling of coldness, often accompanied by shivering. It can also refer to a feeling of fear or anxiety. As a verb, to chill means to make something cold, or to relax and take it easy.

words.tr:
v. 征收；征税；征募
n. 征兵；征税
words.ex: The government will levy a new tax next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将征收一项新税。
words.en: To levy means to impose or collect a tax, fee, or fine. It can also refer to the act of enlisting or drafting individuals into military service.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.ex: The floor is dirty after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，地板变得肮脏了。
words.en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.ex: The motorist stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这位驾车者在红灯前停下了车。
words.en: A motorist is a person who drives a car.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: He works in a small cubicle at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室的一个小隔间里工作。
words.en: A cubicle is a small space or compartment that is partitioned off, especially one in which someone works or studies.

words.tr:
adj. 一千年的
n. 千禧世代
words.ex: Millennial workers prefer flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 千禧一代的员工更喜欢灵活的工作时间。
words.en: Relating to a millennium or the millennials, the generation of people born between the early 1980s and the late 1990s.

words.tr: n. 口号，流行语，（字典等每页上端的）标字
words.ex: His catchword is 'never give up'.
words.ex_cn: 他的口头禅是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A catchword is a word or phrase that becomes very popular or well-known, often because it is used a lot in the media or in advertising.

words.tr: adj. 目光敏锐的；有洞察力的
words.ex: She remained clear-eyed about the challenges ahead.
words.ex_cn: adj. 她对即将面临的挑战保持清醒的认识。
words.en: adj. Having a clear and perceptive understanding or view.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了欧洲。
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: He tried to evade the police by driving fast.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过高速驾驶来逃避警察。
words.en: If you evade something, you find a way of not doing something that you really ought to do.

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.ex: The innermost part of the box was empty.
words.ex_cn: 盒子最内部是空的。
words.en: The innermost part of something is the part that is farthest from its edges or its surface.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr: v. 影响；“affect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 染病的；受感动的；
words.ex: The rain affected the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨影响了比赛。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as affected, you disapprove of the fact that they behave in an unnatural way that is intended to impress other people.

words.ex: The aristocrat lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: An aristocrat is a person of high rank in a society, especially one who inherits a title and lands.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.tr: adj. 深层的；根深蒂固的
words.ex: Her deep-seated fear of failure motivated her to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她对失败的根深蒂固的恐惧促使她更加努力地工作。
words.en: A deep-seated problem, feeling, or belief is difficult to change because its causes have been there for a long time.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.tr: adj. 濒临灭绝的；有灭绝危险的； v. “endanger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种濒临灭绝的动物。
words.en: An animal or plant that is endangered is in danger of becoming extinct.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: The filer submitted his tax report on time.
words.ex_cn: 申报人按时提交了他的报税表。
words.en: A filer is someone or something that files documents or papers.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.tr: n. 行会；同业公会；协会；
words.ex: The medieval guild controlled the price of bread.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的行会控制了面包的价格。
words.en: A guild is an organization of people who do the same job or have the same interests.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.tr: n. 最大赌注；头奖；积累的赌金；最大成功
words.ex: He won the jackpot after betting all his money.
words.ex_cn: 他押上全部钱后赢得了最大赌注。
words.en: The jackpot is the most valuable prize or amount of money in a game or lottery.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.tr: v. 使增加至最大限度；最大化；
words.ex: He tries to maximize his profit by selling more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多卖东西来使利润达到最大。
words.en: To maximize something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: There was an outpouring of love after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，人们倾注了满满的爱。
words.en: An outpouring is a very strong expression of feeling or emotion that is expressed openly and often in large amounts.

words.ex: Her words were prompting him to try again.
words.ex_cn: 她的话激励他再次尝试。
words.en: The action of saying something to persuade, encourage, or remind someone to do or say something.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: Use water sparingly during the drought.
words.ex_cn: 在干旱期间要节约用水。
words.en: If you do something sparingly, you do it in a very limited or restrained way.

words.ex: The taxpayer paid his taxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 纳税人按时缴税了。
words.en: A taxpayer is a person or organization that pays taxes to the government.

words.tr: n. 侵权行为（不构成刑事犯罪但可引起民事诉讼)
words.ex: He was charged with tort for damaging the car.
words.ex_cn: 他因损坏汽车被指控为侵权。
words.en: A tort is a wrongful act or an infringement of a right leading to civil legal liability.

words.tr: n. 监视器；看守人；岗哨
words.ex: The watcher recorded the activity through the camera.
words.ex_cn: 监视器通过摄像头记录了活动。
words.en: A watcher is someone who watches or observes something or someone, often to ensure that nothing bad happens.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.tr:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞；用降落伞空投
words.ex: He jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.ex_cn: 他从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
words.en: A parachute is a device used to slow the motion of an object through an atmosphere by creating drag.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: He reneged on his promise to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他背弃了帮助我的承诺。
words.en: If someone reneges on a promise or an agreement, they do not do what they have promised or agreed to do.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.tr:
n. 钩；扣；紧握；紧抱
v. 抱紧；握紧；扣紧
words.ex: The necklace has a gold clasp.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链有一个金色的钩。
words.en: A clasp is a small device that fastens something, or the act of holding someone or something tightly.

words.ex: We have dinner together in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.ex: He has an insatiable hunger for knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 他对知识有着无法满足的渴望。
words.en: If someone is insatiable, they always want more of something and are never satisfied.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: There are altogether five apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上面总共有五个苹果。
words.en: Altogether is used to emphasize that something is completely the case or to indicate the total number or amount of something.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.tr:
n. 打印；印刷；
v. 打印；印刷；
words.ex: The print of the photo is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片的打印很清晰。
words.en: To produce text or pictures on paper, usually using a machine called a printer.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.tr: n. 不敏感；麻木不仁；感觉迟钝
words.ex: His insensitivity hurt his friend's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他的冷漠伤害了朋友的感情。
words.en: The quality of not being aware of or not being able to understand other people's feelings.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不重要的；
words.ex: The mistake was insignificant and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误无关紧要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as insignificant, you mean that they are small or unimportant, and therefore not worth considering seriously.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: n. 失望（或不愉快）的局面；失败；无赖；游民
words.ex: It's a bummer that the game got canceled.
words.ex_cn: 比赛取消了，真遗憾。
words.en: If you say that something is a bummer, you mean that it is unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr: n. 从0到9的任一数字；手指；脚趾；
words.ex: The password has four digits.
words.ex_cn: 这个密码有四位数字。
words.en: A digit is a written symbol for any of the numbers 0 to 9.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.tr: n. 神职人员；教士；牧师
words.ex: The clergyman preached to the small church on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在星期天向小教堂的会众布道。
words.en: A clergyman is a male priest, minister, or religious leader, especially in the Christian Church.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.tr: v. 破坏; （使）败坏( corrupt的过去式和过去分词 ); （使）腐化; 引起（计算机文件等
words.ex: The file was corrupted after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 断电后，这个文件被损坏了。
words.en: Damaged or made morally or functionally worse, often by the introduction of something undesirable or harmful.

words.ex: He will delete the old file.
words.ex_cn: 他会删除那个旧文件。
words.en: To delete something means to remove it or erase it.

words.tr: n. 驾驶； v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的现在分词； adj. 强有力的；推动的；
words.ex: Driving is his favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 驾驶是他最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of controlling and steering a vehicle.

words.ex: The coach endorses the new player.
words.ex_cn: 教练支持这位新球员。
words.en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.ex: He loves filmmaking and makes short movies every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱电影制作，每个周末都拍短片。
words.en: The process or art of making films.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.ex: Fifty percent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: A percent is a unit of measure equal to one hundredth of a whole. It is often used to express proportions, rates, and comparisons in various contexts, such as finance, statistics, and everyday calculations.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.ex: The sign helped redirect the traffic away from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志帮助将车流改道，避开事故现场。
words.en: To direct something to a new or different place or purpose.

words.tr: adj. 易反应的；应答的；回答的；
words.ex: The child is responsive to his mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子对母亲的声音反应灵敏。
words.en: If someone or something is responsive, they react quickly and favorably.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: He shoved his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群。
words.en: To push someone or something in a rough or careless way.

words.ex: He explained the rules specifically.
words.ex_cn: 他具体地解释了规则。
words.en: You use specifically to emphasize that something is given special attention and considered separately from other things of the same kind.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.tr: v. 使用不足；使用...不当
words.ex: The machine is underused because few people know how to operate it.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器使用不足，因为很少有人知道如何操作它。
words.en: To use something less than it could or should be used.

words.tr: n. 分水岭；集水区；转折点
words.ex: The river forms a watershed between two valleys.
words.ex_cn: 这条河构成了两个山谷之间的分水岭。
words.en: A watershed is an event or period that is important because it represents a big change in how people do or think about something.

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: He is impressionable and easily believes what others say.
words.ex_cn: 他容易受影响，很容易相信别人说的话。
words.en: Someone who is impressionable is easily influenced by other people's opinions or actions.

words.ex: She drank water to assuage her thirst.
words.ex_cn: 她喝水来缓解口渴。
words.en: If you assuage an unpleasant feeling that someone has, you make them feel it less strongly. To assuage a problem or situation means to make it less intense or severe.

words.ex: The country has a debt of one trillion dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一万亿美元的债务。
words.en: A trillion is a number equal to 10^12 in the American system or 10^18 in the British system.

words.tr: n. 轻便双轮马车；小快艇；现场演唱会；工作
words.ex: The farmer rode in a gig to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫乘坐一辆轻便双轮马车去市场。
words.en: A gig is a live performance by musicians or comedians, or a temporary job or task.

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: There is ample food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.ex: The storm was formidable and destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴很可怕，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: He carries his books in a small burse.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一个小钱包里。
words.en: A burse is a small bag or pouch for carrying money, or a scholarship awarded to a student.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: Animals engage in procreation to continue their species.
words.ex_cn: 动物通过生殖来延续它们的物种。
words.en: Procreation is the act of producing young or offspring.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场买苹果。
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.ex: He disappointed his parents by failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格，让父母失望了。
words.en: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you expected them to do.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.tr: v. 公开承认；宣布；声称
words.ex: He professes to love music.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己热爱音乐。
words.en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: He is sceptical about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: If you are sceptical about something, you have doubts about it.

words.ex: He is skeptical about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: If you are skeptical about something, you have doubts about it.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.tr:
n. 旁路；
v. 绕过；
words.ex: The city built a bypass around the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建了一条绕过老城区的旁路。
words.en: If you bypass a place or a system, you avoid it or go around it instead of going through it.

words.ex: He showed his disapproval by staying silent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过保持沉默表示反对。
words.en: Disapproval is the feeling that someone or something is bad, wrong, or unacceptable.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
